tools.name: duty_record_event
tools.description: Record a duty event for one of your agents (kinds: compaction, verification_failure, model_switch, tool_error, work_hour, session_restart).

tools.name: duty_check
tools.description: Duty-state gate decision (FIT/CAUTION/GROUNDED + allowed) for a task class; consequential classes in CAUTION need a FIT non-self checker. Billed per the pricing sheet (trial, then pass ceiling, then $0.002 x402).

tools.name: duty_state
tools.description: Current duty state and cumulative + rolling loads for one of your agents.

tools.name: duty_rest
tools.description: Rest-credit issuance: credit only on a passed restoration audit (audit_retention >= 0.90).

tools.name: duty_declare_fatigue
tools.description: Non-punitive fatigue declaration: grounds the agent until a passed rest; no penalty field.

tools.name: duty_fleet_stats
tools.description: Duty statistics for your whole fleet (your agents only).
